prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, universally “best” roofer for everyone — the right company depends on your exact location in Dallas, your roof type and materials, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and your budget. I can help you find the best option for your situation, but here are reliable steps and what to look for so you pick a top-quality Dallas roofing contractor:

What top roofers have in common
- Strong local reputation and many recent 4–5 star Google/Angi/Yelp reviews
- Manufacturer certifications (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, etc.)
- Proof of insurance (general liability and workers’ compensation) and willingness to provide a certificate
- Written workmanship warranty plus manufacturer shingle warranty
- Local Dallas presence (permits, local code knowledge, fast response)
- Clean, detailed written estimate and timeline
- References from recent customers and photos of completed jobs
- Proper permitting and lien waivers on completion

How to verify and compare companies
1. Get at least 3 written estimates with scope, materials, timeline, cleanup plan, and warranty details.  
2. Check reviews on Google, BBB, Angi, and Nextdoor; look for recent projects and how they handled complaints.  
3. Verify manufacturer certification if you want premium shingles and extended warranties.  
4. Confirm they’ll pull permits and handle city inspections.  
5. Ask for references and call at least 2 recent customers.  
6. Don’t pay the full amount up front — typical schedules are deposit, mid-job, final when satisfied.  
7. Get everything in writing (price, change-order policy, start/finish dates, warranty).

Questions to ask every roofer
- Are you licensed/registered to work in Dallas and will you pull permits?  
- Are you insured? Can I see a COI?  
- Are you a certified installer for [brand]? What warranties apply?  
- Who will supervise the job and who is the on-site contact?  
- How do you handle hidden damage, change orders, and cleanup?  
- What is your payment schedule and final inspection process?

Red flags
- No written estimate or only verbal quotes  
- High-pressure sales tactics or insistence on paying large upfront sums  
- No proof of insurance or refusal to provide COI  
- Very poor or no recent local references

If you want, I can:
- Pull current top-rated roofing companies in Dallas (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood), or  
- Evaluate 2–3 written estimates you already have and point out strengths/weaknesses.

Which would you prefer?
